speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please sit down and tell me exactly what behaviors you and your wife have observed that make you concerned for my patient's safety and mental state. To help me understand the urgency, have there been any sudden changes in his personality, speech, or recent memory?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very serious situation. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia (Paranoid type) with acute agitation and psychotic symptoms.

The clinical picture of 6 weeks of bizarre behavior, fixed delusions of persecution (NSA surveillance) and grandiosity (mind control device), coupled with 3 months of withdrawal and depression, is highly suggestive of schizophrenia. Given the safety risk posed by his agitation and potential for harm to himself or others, immediate hospital admission is indicated. Would you like to proceed with ordering a baseline metabolic panel and urinalysis to rule out substance-induced psychosis or medical causes?
